fullText.simplified:
十二、希望你快乐

    小黄猫：
    你好吗？希望你已经到猫乐园了。
    很久没有和你说话了，我真想你。现在是晚上十二点，我和小白在一辆房车上。虽然车里很舒服，但我们在想办法离开这儿。
    上次和你说到哪儿了？啊，想起来了，我说我和小白下雪山了。是的，我们已经下雪山了。刚下来的时候，我们很高兴，但没有高兴多长时间，我们就遇到了一只黑色的大雕。他是雪山上那只大雕的爸爸，他在找小白，他说他儿子死了，他要吃了小白。我和小白爬进了一个地洞，在地洞里遇到了鼠兔。我以前没有来过高原，不知道高原的地下有那么深的地洞，也不知道地洞里还住着动物。你认识一只叫“元元”的鼠兔吗？他说他见过你。他真是个好人，他带我们走出了地洞，还把我们送到了公路旁边。
    我和小白想在公路那儿坐汽车。但没想到还没坐上汽车，那只大雕就又找到我们了。那时候的天气坏极了，风很大，雨也很大，我和小白都觉得我们要完了。就在快被大雕抓住的时候，一辆房车发现了我们。我和小白跳上了房车，那只大雕再也抓不到我们了，这真是太好了。
    房车里有一个女孩和一个男孩，他们是男女朋友。他们是来这儿旅游的，现在他们要回拉萨了。女孩叫左文文，男孩叫李想。左文文对我和小白很好，她的声音很好听，她是个好女孩。我很喜欢她，我觉得她像我的人妈妈。李想……我觉得他也不错，但没想到他要卖了我和小白，这是我刚刚听到他和别人打电话时说的话。
    所以，现在我和小白在想怎么离开房车。三天后我们会到拉萨，在那以前，我们一定会离开的。离开以后，我就去找你。我应该很快就能找到你，因为这儿离猫乐园不远了。
    希望你快乐！
    想你的饭饭
fullText.traditional:
十二、希望你快樂

    小黃貓：
    你好嗎？希望你已經到貓樂園了。
    很久沒有和你說話了，我真想你。現在是晚上十二點，我和小白在一輛房車上。雖然車裡很舒服，但我們在想辦法離開這兒。
    上次和你說到哪兒了？啊，想起來了，我說我和小白下雪山了。是的，我們已經下雪山了。剛下來的時候，我們很高興，但沒有高興多長時間，我們就遇到了一隻黑色的大鵰。他是雪山上那隻大鵰的爸爸，他在找小白，他說他兒子死了，他要吃了小白。我和小白爬進了一個地洞，在地洞裡遇到了鼠兔。我以前沒有來過高原，不知道高原的地下有那麼深的地洞，也不知道地洞裡還住著動物。你認識一隻叫“元元”的鼠兔嗎？他說他見過你。他真是個好人，他帶我們走出了地洞，還把我們送到了公路旁邊。
    我和小白想在公路那兒坐汽車。但沒想到還沒坐上汽車，那隻大鵰就又找到我們了。那時候的天氣壞極了，風很大，雨也很大，我和小白都覺得我們要完了。就在快被大鵰抓住的時候，一輛房車發現了我們。我和小白跳上了房車，那隻大鵰再也抓不到我們了，這真是太好了。
    房車裡有一個女孩和一個男孩，他們是男女朋友。他們是來這兒旅遊的，現在他們要回拉薩了。女孩叫左文文，男孩叫李想。左文文對我和小白很好，她的聲音很好聽，她是個好女孩。我很喜歡她，我覺得她像我的人媽媽。李想……我覺得他也不錯，但沒想到他要賣了我和小白，這是我剛剛聽到他和別人打電話時說的話。
    所以，現在我和小白在想怎麼離開房車。三天後我們會到拉薩，在那以前，我們一定會離開的。離開以後，我就去找你。我應該很快就能找到你，因為這兒離貓樂園不遠了。
    希望你快樂！
    想你的飯飯

sentences.english: Little yellow cat:

sentences.simplified: 你好吗？希望你已经到猫乐园了。
sentences.traditional: 你好嗎？希望你已經到貓樂園了。
sentences.pinyin: nǐ hǎo ma xī wàng nǐ yǐ jīng dào māo lè yuán le
sentences.english: How are you? Hope you have already arrived at the cat paradise.

sentences.simplified: 很久没有和你说话了，我真想你。现在是晚上十二点，我和小白在一辆房车上。
sentences.traditional: 很久沒有和你說話了，我真想你。現在是晚上十二點，我和小白在一輛房車上。
sentences.pinyin: hěn jiǔ méi yǒu hé nǐ shuō huà le wǒ zhēn xiǎng nǐ xiàn zài shì wǎn shang shí èr diǎn wǒ hé xiǎo bái zài yí liàng fáng chē shang
sentences.english: I haven’t talked to you in a long time. I really miss you. It’s midnight now, and Little Bai and I are in a camper van.

sentences.simplified: 虽然车里很舒服，但我们在想办法离开这儿。
sentences.traditional: 雖然車裡很舒服，但我們在想辦法離開這兒。
sentences.pinyin: suī rán chē lǐ hěn shū fu dàn wǒ men zài xiǎng bàn fǎ lí kāi zhè‘r
sentences.english: Although it’s very comfortable inside the van, we are trying to figure out a way to leave here.

sentences.simplified: 上次和你说到哪儿了？啊，想起来了，我说我和小白下雪山了。
sentences.traditional: 上次和你說到哪兒了？啊，想起來了，我說我和小白下雪山了。
sentences.pinyin: shàng cì hé nǐ shuō dào nǎ'r le à xiǎng qǐ lái le wǒ shuō wǒ hé xiǎo bái xià xuě shān le
sentences.english: Where did we leave off last time? Ah, I remember now, I said that Little Bai and I went down the snowy mountain.

sentences.simplified: 是的，我们已经下雪山了。
sentences.traditional: 是的，我們已經下雪山了。
sentences.pinyin: shì de wǒ men yǐ jīng xià xuě shān le
sentences.english: Yes, we have already come down from the snowy mountain.

sentences.simplified: 刚下来的时候，我们很高兴，但没有高兴多长时间，我们就遇到了一只黑色的大雕。
sentences.traditional: 剛下來的時候，我們很高興，但沒有高興多長時間，我們就遇到了一隻黑色的大鵰。
sentences.pinyin: gāng xià lai de shí hou wǒ men hěn gāo xìng dàn méi yǒu gāo xìng duō cháng shí jiān wǒ men jiù yù dào le yì zhī hēi sè de dà diāo
sentences.english: When we first came down, we were very happy, but our happiness didn’t last long before we encountered a big black eagle.

sentences.simplified: 他是雪山上那只大雕的爸爸，
sentences.traditional: 他是雪山上那隻大鵰的爸爸，
sentences.pinyin: tā shì xuě shān shang nà zhī dà diāo de bà ba
sentences.english: He is the father of that big eagle on the snowy mountain.

sentences.simplified: 他在找小白，他说他儿子死了，他要吃了小白。
sentences.traditional: 他在找小白，他說他兒子死了，他要吃了小白。
sentences.pinyin: tā zài zhǎo xiǎo bái tā shuō tā ér zi sǐ le tā yào chī le xiǎo bái
sentences.english: He was looking for Little Bai, saying his son is dead and he wants to eat Little Bai.

sentences.simplified: 我和小白爬进了一个地洞，在地洞里遇到了鼠兔。
sentences.traditional: 我和小白爬進了一個地洞，在地洞裡遇到了鼠兔。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ hé xiǎo bái pá jìn le yí ge dì dòng zài dì dòng lǐ yù dào le shǔ tù
sentences.english: Little Bai and I crawled into a burrow, where we encountered pikas.

sentences.simplified: 我以前没有来过高原，不知道高原的地下有那么深的地洞，
sentences.traditional: 我以前沒有來過高原，不知道高原的地下有那麼深的地洞，
sentences.pinyin: wǒ yǐ qián méi yǒu lái guò gāo yuán bù zhī dào gāo yuán de dì xià yǒu nà me shēn de dì dòng
sentences.english: I have never been to the plateau before, so I didn’t know there were such deep burrows underground, ..

sentences.simplified: 也不知道地洞里还住着动物。
sentences.traditional: 也不知道地洞裡還住著動物。
sentences.pinyin: yě bù zhī dào dì dòng lǐ hái zhù zhe dòng wù
sentences.english: .. nor did I know that animals lived in those burrows.

sentences.simplified: 你认识一只叫“元元”的鼠兔吗？他说他见过你。
sentences.traditional: 你認識一隻叫“元元”的鼠兔嗎？他說他見過你。
sentences.pinyin: nǐ rèn shi yì zhī jiào yuán yuán de shǔ tù ma tā shuō tā jiàn guò nǐ
sentences.english: Do you know a pika named “Yuanyuan”? He said he has met you.

sentences.simplified: 他真是个好人，他带我们走出了地洞，还把我们送到了公路旁边。
sentences.traditional: 他真是個好人，他帶我們走出了地洞，還把我們送到了公路旁邊。
sentences.pinyin: tā zhēn shì ge hǎo rén tā dài wǒ men zǒu chū le dì dòng hái bǎ wǒ men sòng dào le gōng lù páng biān
sentences.english: He is truly a good person. He led us out of the burrow and even took us to the side of the highway.

sentences.simplified: 我和小白想在公路那儿坐汽车。
sentences.traditional: 我和小白想在公路那兒坐汽車。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ hé xiǎo bái xiǎng zài gōng lù nà'r zuò qì chē
sentences.english: Little Bai and I wanted to get into a car on the highway.

sentences.simplified: 但没想到还没坐上汽车，那只大雕就又找到我们了。
sentences.traditional: 但沒想到還沒坐上汽車，那隻大鵰就又找到我們了。
sentences.pinyin: dàn méi xiǎng dào hái méi zuò shang qì chē nà zhī dà diāo jiù yòu zhǎo dào wǒ men le
sentences.english: But unexpectedly, before we could get into a car, that big eagle found us again.

sentences.simplified: 那时候的天气坏极了，风很大，雨也很大，
sentences.traditional: 那時候的天氣壞極了，風很大，雨也很大，
sentences.pinyin: nà shí hou de tiān qì huài jí le fēng hěn dà yǔ yě hěn dà
sentences.english: The weather at that time was terrible, with strong winds and heavy rain.

sentences.simplified: 我和小白都觉得我们要完了。就在快被大雕抓住的时候，一辆房车发现了我们。
sentences.traditional: 我和小白都覺得我們要完了。就在快被大鵰抓住的時候，一輛房車發現了我們。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ hé xiǎo bái dōu jué de wǒ men yào wán le jiù zài kuài bèi dà diāo zhuā zhù de shí hou yí liàng fáng chē fā xiàn le wǒ men
sentences.english: Both Little Bai and I felt like we were done for. Just as we were about to be caught by the big eagle, a camper van found us.

sentences.simplified: 我和小白跳上了房车，那只大雕再也抓不到我们了，这真是太好了。
sentences.traditional: 我和小白跳上了房車，那隻大鵰再也抓不到我們了，這真是太好了。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ hé xiǎo bái tiào shàng le fáng chē nà zhī dà diāo zài yě zhuā bú dào wǒ men le zhè zhēn shi tài hǎo le
sentences.english: Little Bai and I jumped into the camper van, and that big eagle could no longer catch us. That was really great.

sentences.simplified: 房车里有一个女孩和一个男孩，他们是男女朋友。
sentences.traditional: 房車裡有一個女孩和一個男孩，他們是男女朋友。
sentences.pinyin: fáng chē lǐ yǒu yí ge nǚ hái hé yí ge nán hái tā men shì nán nǚ péng you
sentences.english: In the camper van, there was a girl and a boy. They are boyfriend and girlfriend.

sentences.simplified: 他们是来这儿旅游的，现在他们要回拉萨了。
sentences.traditional: 他們是來這兒旅遊的，現在他們要回拉薩了。
sentences.pinyin: tā men shì lái zhè‘r lǚ yóu de xiàn zài tā men yào huí lā sà le
sentences.english: They came here to travel, and now they are heading back to Lhasa.

sentences.simplified: 女孩叫左文文，男孩叫李想。
sentences.traditional: 女孩叫左文文，男孩叫李想。
sentences.pinyin: nǚ hái jiào zuǒ wén wén nán hái jiào lǐ xiǎng
sentences.english: The girl’s name is Zuo Wenwen, and the boy’s name is Li Xiang.

sentences.simplified: 左文文对我和小白很好，她的声音很好听，她是个好女孩。
sentences.traditional: 左文文對我和小白很好，她的聲音很好聽，她是個好女孩。
sentences.pinyin: zuǒ wén wén duì wǒ hé xiǎo bái hěn hǎo tā de shēng yīn hěn hǎo tīng tā shì ge hǎo nǚ hái
sentences.english: Zuo Wenwen is very kind to Little Bai and me. Her voice is very pleasant. She is a nice girl.

sentences.simplified: 我很喜欢她，我觉得她像我的人妈妈。
sentences.traditional: 我很喜歡她，我覺得她像我的人媽媽。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ hěn xǐ huan tā wǒ jué de tā xiàng wǒ de rén mā ma
sentences.english: I really like her, and I feel like she’s like my human mom.

sentences.simplified: 李想……我觉得他也不错，但没想到他要卖了我和小白，
sentences.traditional: 李想……我覺得他也不錯，但沒想到他要賣了我和小白，
sentences.pinyin: lǐ xiǎng wǒ jué de tā yě bú cuò dàn méi xiǎng dào tā yào mài le wǒ hé xiǎo bái
sentences.english: Li Xiang … I thought he wasn’t bad, but I didn’t expect that he would want to sell me and Little Bai.

sentences.simplified: 这是我刚刚听到他和别人打电话时说的话。
sentences.traditional: 這是我剛剛聽到他和別人打電話時說的話。
sentences.pinyin: zhè shì wǒ gāng gang tīng dào tā hé bié ren dǎ diàn huà shí shuō de huà
sentences.english: This is what I just heard him say on the phone with someone else.

sentences.simplified: 所以，现在我和小白在想怎么离开房车。
sentences.traditional: 所以，現在我和小白在想怎麼離開房車。
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ xiàn zài wǒ hé xiǎo bái zài xiǎng zěn me lí kāi fáng chē
sentences.english: So, now Little Bai and I are thinking about how to leave the camper van.

sentences.simplified: 三天后我们会到拉萨，在那以前，我们一定会离开的。
sentences.traditional: 三天後我們會到拉薩，在那以前，我們一定會離開的。
sentences.pinyin: sān tiān hòu wǒ men huì dào lā sà zài nà yǐ qián wǒ men yí dìng huì lí kāi de
sentences.english: We will arrive in Lhasa in three days, and before that, we will definitely leave.

sentences.simplified: 离开以后，我就去找你。
sentences.traditional: 離開以後，我就去找你。
sentences.pinyin: lí kāi yǐ hòu wǒ jiù qù zhǎo nǐ
sentences.english: After we have left, I will come to find you.

sentences.simplified: 我应该很快就能找到你，因为这儿离猫乐园不远了。
sentences.traditional: 我應該很快就能找到你，因為這兒離貓樂園不遠了。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ yīng gāi hěn kuài jiù néng zhǎo dào nǐ yīn wèi zhè‘r lí māo lè yuán bù yuǎn le
sentences.english: I should be able to find you soon, as it’s not far to the cat paradise from here.

sentences.simplified: 希望你快乐！
sentences.traditional: 希望你快樂！
sentences.pinyin: xī wàng nǐ kuài lè
sentences.english: Hope you are well!

sentences.simplified: 想你的饭饭
sentences.traditional: 想你的飯飯
sentences.pinyin: xiǎng nǐ de fàn fàn
sentences.english: Missing you, Fanfan

sentence_translations: (12) Hope You Are Well
Little yellow cat:
How are you? Hope you have already arrived at the cat paradise.
I haven’t talked to you in a long time. I really miss you. It’s midnight now, and Little Bai and I are in a camper van.
Although it’s very comfortable inside the van, we are trying to figure out a way to leave here.
Where did we leave off last time? Ah, I remember now, I said that Little Bai and I went down the snowy mountain.
Yes, we have already come down from the snowy mountain.
When we first came down, we were very happy, but our happiness didn’t last long before we encountered a big black eagle.
He is the father of that big eagle on the snowy mountain.
He was looking for Little Bai, saying his son is dead and he wants to eat Little Bai.
Little Bai and I crawled into a burrow, where we encountered pikas.
I have never been to the plateau before, so I didn’t know there were such deep burrows underground, ..
.. nor did I know that animals lived in those burrows.
Do you know a pika named “Yuanyuan”? He said he has met you.
He is truly a good person. He led us out of the burrow and even took us to the side of the highway.
Little Bai and I wanted to get into a car on the highway.
But unexpectedly, before we could get into a car, that big eagle found us again.
The weather at that time was terrible, with strong winds and heavy rain.
Both Little Bai and I felt like we were done for. Just as we were about to be caught by the big eagle, a camper van found us.
Little Bai and I jumped into the camper van, and that big eagle could no longer catch us. That was really great.
In the camper van, there was a girl and a boy. They are boyfriend and girlfriend.
They came here to travel, and now they are heading back to Lhasa.
The girl’s name is Zuo Wenwen, and the boy’s name is Li Xiang.
Zuo Wenwen is very kind to Little Bai and me. Her voice is very pleasant. She is a nice girl.
I really like her, and I feel like she’s like my human mom.
Li Xiang … I thought he wasn’t bad, but I didn’t expect that he would want to sell me and Little Bai.
This is what I just heard him say on the phone with someone else.
So, now Little Bai and I are thinking about how to leave the camper van.
We will arrive in Lhasa in three days, and before that, we will definitely leave.
After we have left, I will come to find you.
I should be able to find you soon, as it’s not far to the cat paradise from here.
Hope you are well!
Missing you, Fanfan
